reason: The static semantic audit required by §B FAILED before any model load, and the required G task/domain conditioning is not deterministically bound (§E). required_remediation: Authorize an explicit v1.2 execution-harness amendment that implements the real per-component model construction, strict checkpoint load, canonical precision contexts, synchronized CUDA timing, memory measurement and isolated workers.
Deterministically bind the G task/domain conditioning (task_ids per component and the domain->task_id registry) in the frozen harness BEFORE any forward.
Re-freeze the amended sources and re-issue the execution authorization.
